## Remarks

Node's own `net.isIP`<!-- -->, so it accepts a bare address only — `''`<!-- -->, `'unknown'` and `'10.0.0.0/8'` are all `false`<!-- -->, because a prefix length makes it a CIDR record rather than an address. Use this to screen untrusted input before [Networks](/api/net/latest/net.networks/)<!-- -->, whose constructor throws on anything it cannot parse.
